text: {"lessons":["I will avoid repeatedly switching in and out of the same stock; each trade needs a clear reason and a review of whether the original thesis has changed.","I will not treat a lower price alone as a buying opportunity; I will check the business outlook and valuation before adding to a position.","I will let strong holdings run when their prospects remain sound, trimming only when risk or portfolio concentration warrants it rather than selling just because they have risen."]}
